description:
Store the user's own Attendee account (attendee.dev), which agents join Zoom, Google Meet and Teams meetings through. Bring your own key: the user signs up at app.attendee.dev (or runs Attendee themselves) and creates an API key in their project there. Attendee bills the user for bot hours directly. The key is checked with Attendee before it is saved and is never returned. Calling this again replaces what is stored. For Zoom meetings the user's Attendee project also needs Zoom Meeting SDK credentials, set up in Attendee.

Requires scope `calls:write`.

api_key.description: An API key from the user's Attendee project. Needed the first time and when base_url changes; omit to keep the stored key.

base_url.description: Their Attendee: https://app.attendee.dev (the default) or the address of their own install.

signed_in_bots.description: Signed-in bots show as a named account instead of an anonymous guest that Meet labels "appears to be a bot". Omit to keep what is stored. Not for Zoom.

google_meet.description: Sign in before joining Google Meet. Needs a Google Workspace bot login set up in Attendee.

login_group.description: Attendee bot login group; null uses the oldest.

teams.description: Sign in before joining Teams. Needs a Microsoft 365 bot login set up in Attendee.

webhook_secret.description: Optional: the Attendee project's webhook secret (Settings > Webhooks there), so bot state webhooks are signature-checked. null removes it.

name: connect_meeting_integration
title: Connect Attendee for meetings
